correctness.rationale: The exact signed-unit extension count establishes the uniform rank measures; pulling back independent admissible domains under signed units proves a semigroup-valued independent intersection coupling. The counting of every fixed admissible j-subset proves factorial moments and finite binomial inversion yields all target probabilities; conditional W-invariance yields individual fibers. For maximal proper rank n each pair has independent fair sign compatibility, giving binomial rank, exact zero time, finite expectation and lattice-phased exponential limit. Exhaustive direct-map multiplication validated n=1,2,3 two-factor all-rank and maximal-iterated cases plus 30 mixed triple cases. This is a universal symbolic proof, not an enumeration extrapolation.

value.rationale: The symplectic rook monoid is a classical type-C Renner monoid, and all-arity rank-conditioned structure constants and individual product fibers are natural multiplication invariants, not a routine monoid size recurrence. The maximal proper-rank class exhibits exact independent Bernoulli thinning and logarithmic absorption with lattice phase, a sharp difference from ordinary fixed-corank rook products. The result gives usable finite-time exact probabilities and structural insight for arbitrary products of natural rank class generators.
